app-menu.$description: AppMenu: the main menu of an application, a list of items beside the page of the item chosen, in a panel over a share of the window or over the whole of it.

share.$description: The share of the window the panel takes on a wide screen (0.5: half).

min-size.$description: The least width of the panel: where its share would be narrower, it takes the whole window.

split-size.$description: The least width of the panel that holds the list and the page side by side; a narrower panel shows them in turns.

nav-size.$description: The width of the list beside the page.

close-button.$description: The button at the top of the list that closes the menu.

back-button.$description: The button above a page that took the list's place, back to the list.

panel.$description: The panel at the start edge (`full`: it takes the whole window).

nav.$description: The list's column: the close button and the items (`stacked`: it fills the panel, the page out of sight).

header-slot.$description: The app's own content at the top of the list.

search.$description: The search field above the items.

list.$description: A list of items: the one at the top, and the one at the bottom (`bottom`).

separator.$description: The line between two groups of items.

no-match.$description: What the search says when no item matches.

footer-slot.$description: The app's own content at the bottom of the list.

item.$description: An item: under the pointer, pressed, its page shown, its page shown under the pointer, focused by the keys, disabled.

indicator.$description: The mark on the item whose page is shown, at its start edge, centred along it.

icon.$description: The item's glyph or icon (`selected`: its page is shown).

label.$description: The item's text (`selected`: its page is shown).

page.$description: The page area beside the list: the back button above the page shown.

page-head.$description: The row above a page that took the list's place: the back button.

view.$description: One item's page, scrolling on its own (`focus`: it took focus when it replaced the list).
